cases.name: expanded_card_geometry
cases.scope: Actual paused four-turn helper: illustration, title, description, four original turn slots, category and gold-frame gaps remain legible.

cases.name: space_continue_fold
cases.scope: Space sends original continue action: details fold away and the four turn slots remain without squashing the illustration.

cases.name: next_card_pause
cases.scope: Next event expands with original one turn slot and the continue/disable-pause prompt restored.

cases.name: disable_pause_hotspot
cases.scope: Click original lower-right disable-pause prompt; remaining deal completes to five folded hand cards without further pause prompts.

cases.name: settings_pause
cases.scope: Click original left Settings button: menu appears over darkened, stationary table with four rectangular indicators.

cases.name: native_en_badge
cases.scope: Click visible left EN badge: actual menu reads Resume / Pause per Card / Fast Mode / Sound / Tutorial; work labels change to English.

cases.name: native_zh_badge
cases.scope: Click visible right 中 badge: actual menu and work labels return to Chinese.

cases.name: auto_pause_toggle
cases.scope: Click first row: indicator becomes muted green; next row observation exposes it without highlight. Restored initial on state.

cases.name: fast_mode_toggle_and_restore
cases.scope: Click second row: muted green indicator and top-right fast marker appear; later click restores off.

cases.name: sound_toggle_and_restore
cases.scope: Click third row: original indicator changes from muted green to clay red; second click restores muted green. This is a visual/state check, not a listening test.

cases.name: tutorial_toggle_and_restore
cases.scope: Click fourth row: indicator becomes muted green, then second click restores clay red; no tutorial-content playthrough claimed.

cases.name: hover_feedback
cases.scope: Highlights follow original option row and language badge hotspots while keeping indicator shapes and no added controls.

cases.name: settings_resume
cases.scope: Click original vertical Resume/继续 button: dark overlay and menu clear; end-turn button and folded hand remain available in same geometry.

cases.scope: Actual normal table: shallow paper title, dark ink company name, five readable tracks and counts, paper/old-gold button and folded hand surfaces match the new palette.
